execution.dependencies: Existing toolchain/libevent symlinks and scoped BendTT kernel reused; no setup or global installation.
execution.heavy_work: One heavy run at a time under the repository parent mkdir lock. Ledger tasks took their own lock. make test took and released the lock externally.
execution.publication: No push, tag, release or publication.

limits: Universal 404/405 laws start from Selection; URI matching and method collection have concrete table proofs/tests, not a general matching theorem.
The declared-status theorem covers pure transfer outcomes, not all adapter errors or socket/encoder fallbacks.
Original-operation preservation is relative to the supplied original; receipt lookup and JSON/domain conversion are tested edges.
GET/HEAD preservation covers complete modeled state; effectful adapter writes remain tested/reviewed.
The new protected accounts route uses a fixed public demo value, not a real credential validation system.
BendTT translation, Base semantics, native code generation/runtime, SQLite and transport remain trusted.
